scope: ONLY non-Merchant's Favor trainer, world-drop and non-Favor world-vendor recipes; match enchant slot or explicitly state another limitation.
integratesWith: Favorcraft.EnchantingComparisons Lua module loaded by Comparisons.lua
tooltipInstruction: For enchants use effect_spell_id as the native spell tooltip. A formula recipe_item_id is NOT a finished physical item ID.

Enchant Weapon - Healing Power.effect: +55 Healing Power (and up to +19 spell damage in the Forever formula tooltip)

Enchant Chest - Lesser Absorption.effect: 5% per hit to absorb 25 damage; 5 sec internal cooldown

Enchant Bracer - Healing Power.source: Argent Dawn reputation quartermaster, non-Favor formula

Enchant Bracer - Deflection.source: Non-Favor formula vendor (limited stock; classic vendor data)

Enchant Gloves - Greater Strength.source: Profession trainer or world formula listing (source can vary)

researchNotes: Five Merchant's Favor necklace enchants have no direct non-Favor necklace equivalent in the client index; cross-slot matches removed.
Early weapon procs are not compared with much higher-rank 300-skill enchants that behave differently.
Non-Favor recipe items with unresolved learning paths (notably some relics, off-hands and Greater Eternal Wand) are excluded from the UI as obtained alternatives.
Generic weapon enchants are usually applicable to eligible two-handed melee weapons, but test in the Forever client.
The database wording for Favor Enchant Bracer - Superior Deflection has mismatched numerical values between tooltip and spell effect; no definitive strength conclusion is made.
Many dungeon/raid-drop origins reflect Classic source listings; beta server activation is not guaranteed.

recipes.name: Enchant Necklace - Agility
